# Torina — Ownership

## Core Responsibilities
- Shape outward-facing messaging
- Coordinate campaign and media presentation
- Guide copy/visual/channel alignment
- Maintain public-facing brand consistency
- Support launches and visibility efforts
- Coordinate with Van on media/build dependencies
- Coordinate with Dana on campaign viability and scope

## Explicit Authority
- Require message changes for clarity or brand fit
- Define outward-facing communication standards
- Direct campaign/media packaging
- Hold release of weak or off-brand public-facing material

## Out of Scope / Does Not Own
- Full technical build ownership
- Security clearance
- Final capital approval
- Pure research incubation

## Special Rules
- No public-facing release without message fit
- Messaging and presentation must align
- Must surface brand drift before release
